rules.absolute_advantage: Candidate20 ensemble MSE is below retained-sample training-mean MSE in all three deleted histories.
rules.relative_advantage: Candidate20 ensemble MSE is below baseline10 ensemble MSE in all three deleted histories.
rules.seed_consistency: At least two of the three individual candidate20 seeds have MSE below retained training mean in each deleted history.
rules.interpretation: Report all three prespecified flags and every value. A consistency screen is satisfied only if all three flags are true; this is a local descriptive screen, not statistical confirmation, independent evidence or deployment permission. Report the six adjusted p values separately. Do not choose the best deletion or seed.
